title: अष्टादशोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 18 · The Samshaptakas return and Drona attacks

summary.en: The Samshaptakas turn back, and Arjuna destroys their elephants and chariots with arrows that rain like Indra's thunderbolts. While he is occupied, Drona drives against Yudhishthira's guarded array.
summary.kn: ಸಂಶಪ್ತಕರು ಮರಳಿ ಬರುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಅರ್ಜುನ ಇಂದ್ರನ ವಜ್ರದಂತೆ ಸುರಿಯುವ ಬಾಣಗಳಿಂದ ಅವರ ಆನೆ, ರಥಗಳನ್ನು ನಾಶಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಅವನು ತೊಡಗಿರುವಾಗ ದ್ರೋಣ ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನ ರಕ್ಷಿತ ವ್ಯೂಹದ ಮೇಲೆ ನುಗ್ಗುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: संशप्तक लौटते हैं, और अर्जुन इन्द्र के वज्र जैसे बाणों से उनके हाथियों और रथों को नष्ट करते हैं। जब वे व्यस्त हैं तब द्रोण युधिष्ठिर के रक्षित व्यूह पर चढ़ते हैं।
summary.te: సంశప్తకులు వెనుదిరిగి వస్తారు; అర్జునుడు ఇంద్రవజ్రంలా కురిసే బాణాలతో వారి ఏనుగులను, రథాలను నాశనం చేస్తాడు. అతడు నిమగ్నమై ఉండగా ద్రోణుడు యుధిష్ఠిరుని రక్షిత వ్యూహంపై దూకుతాడు.
summary.ta: சம்சப்தகர் திரும்பி வர, அர்ஜுனன் இந்திரனின் வஜ்ரம் போல் பொழியும் அம்புகளால் அவர்களின் யானை, தேர்களை அழிக்கிறான். அவன் ஈடுபட்டிருக்கையில் த்ரோணர் யுதிஷ்டிரரின் காக்கப்பட்ட அணியைத் தாக்குகிறார்.
summary.ml: സംശപ്തകർ പിന്തിരിയുന്നു; ഇന്ദ്രന്റെ വജ്രായുധംപോലെ പെയ്യുന്ന അമ്പുകൊണ്ട് അർജുനൻ അവരുടെ ആനകളെയും രഥങ്ങളെയും നശിപ്പിക്കുന്നു. അർജുനൻ തിരക്കിലായിരിക്കെ ദ്രോണർ കാവലുള്ള യുധിഷ്ഠിരന്റെ വ്യൂഹത്തിനെതിരെ തേര് ഓടിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 7.18; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Tue Sep 22 2026

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
दृष्ट्वा तु संनिवृत्तांस्तान्संशप्तकगणान्पुनः ।
वासुदेवं महात्मानमर्जुनः समभाषत ॥

meaning.en: Seeing those Samshaptaka bands turn back again, Arjuna spoke to the great-souled Vasudeva.

verses.text:
चोदयाश्वान्हृषीकेश संशप्तकगणान्प्रति ।
नैते हास्यन्ति संग्रामं जीवन्त इति मे मतिः ॥

meaning.en: "Drive the horses, Hrishikesha, toward the Samshaptaka bands. I think they will not give up the battle alive.

verses.text:
पश्य मेऽस्त्रबलं घोरं बाह्वोरिष्वसनस्य च ।
अद्यैतान्पातयिष्यामि क्रुद्धो रुद्रः पशूनिव ॥

meaning.en: See the terrible power of my weapons and of the strength in my arms. Today I will cut them down, like angry Rudra among beasts."

verses.text:
ततः कृष्णः स्मितं कृत्वा परिणन्द्य शिवेन तम् ।
प्रावेशयत दुर्धर्षो यत्र यत्रैच्छदर्जुनः ॥

meaning.en: Then Krishna, smiling, answered him with blessings and drove the unassailable chariot wherever Arjuna wished.

verses.text:
बभ्राजे स रथोऽत्यर्थमुह्यमानो रणे तदा ।
उह्यमानमिवाकाशे विमानं पाण्डुरैर्हयैः ॥

meaning.en: The chariot, borne through the battle, shone greatly, like an aerial car carried across the sky by white horses.

verses.text:
मण्डलानि ततश्चक्रे गतप्रत्यागतानि च ।
यथा शक्ररथो राजन्युद्धे देवासुरे पुरा ॥

meaning.en: He made circles, advancing and retreating, like Shakra's chariot, O king, in the old war of gods and asuras.

verses.text:
अथ नारायणाः क्रुद्धा विविधायुधपाणयः ।
छादयन्तः शरव्रातैः परिवव्रुर्धनंजयम् ॥

meaning.en: Then the enraged Narayanas, weapons of many kinds in hand, surrounded Dhananjaya, covering him with showers of arrows.

verses.text:
अदृश्यं च मुहूर्तेन चक्रुस्ते भरतर्षभ ।
कृष्णेन सहितं युद्धे कुन्तीपुत्रं धनंजयम् ॥

meaning.en: In a moment, bull of the Bharatas, they made Dhananjaya, Kunti's son, unseen in the battle, together with Krishna.

verses.text:
क्रुद्धस्तु फल्गुनः संख्ये द्विगुणीकृतविक्रमः ।
गाण्डीवमुपसंमृज्य तूर्णं जग्राह संयुगे ॥

meaning.en: But Phalguna, enraged, with his valor doubled in battle, wiped the Gandiva and quickly took it up in the fight.

verses.text:
बद्ध्वा च भृकुटीं वक्त्रे क्रोधस्य प्रतिलक्षणम् ।
देवदत्तं महाशङ्खं पूरयामास पाण्डवः ॥

meaning.en: Knitting his brows, the sign of anger on his face, the Pandava filled the great conch Devadatta with breath.

verses.text:
अथास्त्रमरिसंघघ्नं त्वाष्ट्रमभ्यस्यदर्जुनः ।
ततो रूपसहस्राणि प्रादुरासन्पृथक्पृथक् ॥

meaning.en: Then Arjuna invoked the weapon of Tvashtri, the destroyer of enemy hosts, and thousands of forms appeared separately.

verses.text:
आत्मनः प्रतिरूपैस्तैर्नानारूपैर्विमोहिताः ।
अन्योन्यमर्जुनं मत्वा स्वमात्मानं च जघ्निरे ॥

meaning.en: Bewildered by those many forms, each a copy of Arjuna, they took one another for Arjuna and struck even themselves.

verses.text:
अयमर्जुनोऽयं गोविन्द इमौ यादवपाण्डवौ ।
इति ब्रुवाणाः संमूढा जघ्नुरन्योन्यमाहवे ॥

meaning.en: "This is Arjuna, this is Govinda, these are the Yadava and the Pandava," they cried, and, thoroughly bewildered, killed one another in the battle.

verses.text:
मोहिताः परमास्त्रेण क्षयं जग्मुः परस्परम् ।
अशोभन्त रणे योधाः पुष्पिता इव किंशुकाः ॥

meaning.en: Deluded by that supreme weapon, they destroyed each other, and the warriors in the battle shone like blossoming kimshuka trees.

verses.text:
ततः शरसहस्राणि तैर्विमुक्तानि भस्मसात् ।
कृत्वा तदस्त्रं तान्वीराननयद्यमसादनम् ॥

meaning.en: Then that weapon reduced to ashes the thousands of arrows they had loosed, and led those heroes to Yama's abode.

verses.text:
अथ प्रहस्य बीभत्सुर्ललित्थान्मालवानपि ।
माचेल्लकांस्त्रिगर्तांश्च यौधेयांश्चार्दयच्छरैः ॥

meaning.en: Then Bibhatsu, laughing, afflicted the Lalitthas, Malavas, Machellakas, Trigartas and Yaudheyas with arrows.

verses.text:
ते वध्यमाना वीरेण क्षत्रियाः कालचोदिताः ।
व्यसृजञ्शरवर्षाणि पार्थे नानाविधानि च ॥

meaning.en: Struck by that hero, those Kshatriyas, driven by fate, loosed showers of arrows of many kinds at Partha.

verses.text:
ततो नैवार्जुनस्तत्र न रथो न च केशवः ।
प्रत्यदृश्यत घोरेण शरवर्षेण संवृतः ॥

meaning.en: Then neither Arjuna nor his chariot nor Keshava could be seen there, covered by a terrible rain of arrows.

verses.text:
ततस्ते लब्धलक्ष्यत्वादन्योन्यमभिचुक्रुशुः ।
हतौ कृष्णाविति प्रीता वासांस्यादुधुवुस्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Thinking they had hit the mark, they shouted to one another, and, pleased, thinking "Both Krishnas are slain," waved their garments.

verses.text:
भेरीमृदङ्गशङ्खांश्च दध्मुर्वीराः सहस्रशः ।
सिंहनादरवांश्चोग्रांश्चक्रिरे तत्र मारिष ॥

meaning.en: Heroes by the thousand blew kettledrums, mridangas and conches, and made fierce lion roars there, respected sir.

verses.text:
ततः प्रसिष्विदे कृष्णः खिन्नश्चार्जुनमब्रवीत् ।
क्वासि पार्थ न पश्ये त्वां कच्चिज्जीवसि शत्रुहन् ॥

meaning.en: Then Krishna sweated, weary, and said to Arjuna, "Where are you, Partha? I do not see you. Slayer of foes, are you alive?"

verses.text:
तस्य तं मानुषं भावं भावज्ञोऽऽज्ञाय पाण्डवः ।
वायव्यास्त्रेण तैरस्तां शरवृष्टिमपाहरत् ॥

meaning.en: Knowing his feeling, that human mood of Krishna, the Pandava with the weapon of Vayu swept away the rain of arrows they had shot.

verses.text:
ततः संशप्तकव्रातान्साश्वद्विपरथायुधान् ।
उवाह भगवान्वायुः शुष्कपर्णचयानिव ॥

meaning.en: Then the blessed Vayu bore away the Samshaptaka bands with their horses, elephants, chariots and weapons like heaps of dry leaves.

verses.text:
उह्यमानास्तु ते राजन्बह्वशोभन्त वायुना ।
प्रडीनाः पक्षिणः काले वृक्षेभ्य इव मारिष ॥

meaning.en: Borne by the wind, they shone in numbers, respected sir, like birds flying from trees at the right season.

verses.text:
तांस्तथा व्याकुलीकृत्य त्वरमाणो धनंजयः ।
जघान निशितैर्बाणैः सहस्राणि शतानि च ॥

meaning.en: Having thus thrown them into confusion, Dhananjaya quickly killed with sharp arrows thousands and hundreds of them.

verses.text:
शिरांसि भल्लैरहरद्बाहूनपि च सायुधान् ।
हस्तिहस्तोपमांश्चोरूञ्शरैरुर्व्यामपातयत् ॥

meaning.en: With bhallas he took off heads and arms with weapons, and with arrows felled to the ground thighs like elephants' trunks.

verses.text:
पृष्ठच्छिन्नान्विचरणान्विमस्तिष्केक्षणाङ्गुलीन् ।
नानाङ्गावयवैर्हीनांश्चकारारीन्धनंजयः ॥

meaning.en: Dhananjaya left his enemies with backs cut, legs cut, brains, eyes and fingers gone, and deprived of various limbs.

verses.text:
गन्धर्वनगराकारान्विधिवत्कल्पितान्रथान् ।
शरैर्विशकलीकुर्वंश्चक्रे व्यश्वरथद्विपान् ॥

meaning.en: Shattering with arrows the chariots, fitted by rule and looking like cities of the gandharvas, he made them horseless, chariotless and elephantless.

verses.text:
मुण्डतालवनानीव तत्र तत्र चकाशिरे ।
छिन्नध्वजरथव्राताः केचित्केचित्क्वचित्क्वचित् ॥

meaning.en: Here and there they shone like groves of stripped palm trees, some with banners and chariot-masses cut down, some here, some there.

verses.text:
सोत्तरायुधिनो नागाः सपताकाङ्कुशायुधाः ।
पेतुः शक्राशनिहता द्रुमवन्त इवाचलाः ॥

meaning.en: Elephants with their coverings and weapons, with banners, goads and arms, fell struck by Shakra's thunderbolt, like tree-covered mountains.

verses.text:
चामरापीडकवचाः स्रस्तान्त्रनयनासवः ।
सारोहास्तुरगाः पेतुः पार्थबाणहताः क्षितौ ॥

meaning.en: Horses with their riders, their chowries, crests and armor, entrails dropping, eyes and lives gone, fell on the ground struck by Partha's arrows.

verses.text:
विप्रविद्धासिनखराश्छिन्नवर्मर्ष्टिशक्तयः ।
पत्तयश्छिन्नवर्माणः कृपणं शेरते हताः ॥

meaning.en: Footmen with swords and claws thrown away, armor, clubs and spears cut, with armor cut, lay wretchedly dead.

verses.text:
तैर्हतैर्हन्यमानैश्च पतद्भिः पतितैरपि ।
भ्रमद्भिर्निष्टनद्भिश्च घोरमायोधनं बभौ ॥

meaning.en: With those slain and those being slain, those falling and those fallen, those wandering and groaning, the battlefield looked terrible.

verses.text:
रजश्च महदुद्भूतं शान्तं रुधिरवृष्टिभिः ।
मही चाप्यभवद्दुर्गा कबन्धशतसंकुला ॥

meaning.en: A great dust that had risen was stilled by rains of blood, and the earth became hard to traverse, thronged with hundreds of headless trunks.

verses.text:
तद्बभौ रौद्रबीभत्सं बीभत्सोर्यानमाहवे ।
आक्रीड इव रुद्रस्य घ्नतः कालात्यये पशून् ॥

meaning.en: That course of Bibhatsu in the battle looked terrible and fearsome, like Rudra's playground when he kills beasts at the end of an age.

verses.text:
ते वध्यमानाः पार्थेन व्याकुलाश्वरथद्विपाः ।
तमेवाभिमुखाः क्षीणाः शक्रस्यातिथितां गताः ॥

meaning.en: Struck by Partha, with their horses, chariots and elephants in confusion, they were destroyed facing him alone and became guests of Shakra.

verses.text:
सा भूमिर्भरतश्रेष्ठ निहतैस्तैर्महारथैः ।
आस्तीर्णा संबभौ सर्वा प्रेतीभूतैः समन्ततः ॥

meaning.en: That ground, best of the Bharatas, strewn on every side with those great chariot-warriors killed, shone as if all covered with the dead.

verses.text:
एतस्मिन्नन्तरे चैव प्रमत्ते सव्यसाचिनि ।
व्यूढानीकस्ततो द्रोणो युधिष्ठिरमुपाद्रवत् ॥

meaning.en: In the meantime, while the left-handed archer was occupied, Drona with his army arrayed rushed at Yudhishthira.

verses.text:
तं प्रत्यगृह्णंस्त्वरिता व्यूढानीकाः प्रहारिणः ।
युधिष्ठिरं परीप्सन्तस्तदासीत्तुमुलं महत् ॥

meaning.en: Those arrayed strikers quickly received him, wishing to protect Yudhishthira, and there was a great tumult.
